title: I Love Being Upsidedown
description: Lets you turn any Player Upsidedown like Dinnerbone/Grumm!
body:
This Mod lets you Turn any Player Upsidedown and its fully Client-Side!

Simply add their Username to the Whitelist in the Config File or use Mod Menu.

Normal Entities will still turn around when being named Dinnerbone/Grumm.

![Showcase of a Player being Upsidedown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hIV6Rbj2/images/da5dee425c1a8f22888f3d6174e9204f5241b091.png)
